full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 67 S. 28 May 2010 SB MEMBER REMA B. SOMO SB MEMBER JUAN C. SENUPE, JR. SB MEMBER REMEGIO GUMBAN Sta. Barbara, Province of Iloilo ABC Pres. WILFREDO SUBONG Sta. Barbara, Province of Iloilo Gentlemen and Lady: 20JO This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion as to who, between the Acting Vice-Mayor and the Floor Leader, should preside over the proceedings of the Sangguniang Bayan of Sta. Barbara in view of the Vice-Mayor's absence. In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 4, series of 2006. In the said legal opinion, we opined that being an Acting Vice-Governor does not automatiéally vest upon the said official the power to preside over the Sangguniang Panlalawigan citing the case of Gamboa vs. Aguirre and Araneta (G.R. No. 134213, 20 July 1999). The remedy to this situation is already provided under Section 49 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) concerning the election of a temporary presiding officer. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Ls/17 Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: my. JESU B. DO Director III
